column3: oṃ aiṃ hīṃ śrīṃ iti mantreṇa taṃ baliṃ kāmarūpiṇam ||
cintayitvā nyasetpuṣpaṃ mūrdhni tasya ca bhairava |
aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ iti mantreṇa dhyātvā khaḍgaṃ prapūjayet |
pūjayitvā tataḥ khaḍgam oṃ āṃ hrīṃ phaḍitimantrakaiḥ ||
oṃ aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ kauśikīti rudhiraṃ dāpayāmi te ||
evaṃ dattvā baliṃ pūrṇaṃ phalaṃ prāpnoti sādhakaḥ ||
balidāne tu durgāyā anyatrāpi vidhiḥ sadā ||
cintayitvā guruṃ mūrdhni yathā varṇādikaṃ bhavet ||
mantraṃ ca kaṇṭhato dhyātvā sitavarṇaṃ hiraṇmayam |
kaṇṭhe trayāṇāṃ nāḍīnāṃ veṣṭanaṃ vidyate nṛṇām |
tat ṣaṭcakramiti proktaṃ śuklaṃ kaṇṭhasya madhyagam |
yasmād ādyaṃ tu hṛdayaṃ tasmādādīti gadyate ||
pūjayitvā tato mālāṃ gṛhṇīyād dakṣiṇe kare |
pūrvabījaṃ japan yastu parabījaṃ ca saṃspṛśet |
devīṃ vicintayan japyaṃ kuryād vāmena na spṛśet ||
nānyaṃ madhye prayoktavyaṃ putrañjīvādikaṃ ca yat ||
tasya kāmaṃ ca mokṣaṃ ca dadāti na priyaṃkarī ||
vinyaset kramatas tasmāt sarpākārā hi sā yataḥ |
dṛḍhaṃ sūtraṃ niyuñjīta jape truṭyati no yathā |
yathā hastānna cyaveta japataḥ srak tamācaret ||
evaṃ yaḥ kurute mālāṃ japaṃ ca japakovidaḥ ||
sa prāpnotīpsitaṃ kāmaṃ hīne syāttu viparyayaḥ |
asaṃkhyātaṃ ca yajjaptaṃ tasya tanniṣphalaṃ bhavet |
japtvā mālāṃ śirodeśe prāṃśusthāne.tha vā nyaset ||
stutipāṭhaṃ tataḥ kuryādiṣṭaṃ kāmaṃ nivedya ca |
śaraṇye tryambake gauri nārāyaṇi namo.stu te |
pañcapraṇāmān kṛtvātha aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ itimantrakaiḥ |
anāmikāyāḥ pṛṣṭhe tu madhyame dve niveśayet ||
trivāraṃ darśayet tāṃ tu mūlamantreṇa sādhakaḥ |
tāṃ mudrāṃ śirasi nyasya maṇḍalaṃ vinyaset tataḥ ||
tatra natvā raktacaṇḍāṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ mantreṇa sādhakaḥ ||
raktacaṇḍāyai nama iti nirmālyaṃ tatra nikṣipet |
udake tarumūle vā nirmālyaṃ tatra saṃtyajet ||
evaṃ yaḥ pūjayed devīṃ vidhānena śivāṃ naraḥ |
naivedyaṃ gandhapuṣpe ca vastraṃ dadyācca yatpriyam |
devyai navamyāṃ sampūrṇaṃ baliṃ dadyād ghṛtādibhiḥ |
dakṣiṇāṃ gurave dadyātsuvarṇaṃ gāṃ tathā tilam ||
kalpeṣu dṛṣṭvā vā mantraṃ gṛhṇīyācchadmanātha vā |
śaṭhe krūre ca mūrkhe ca chadmakāriṇyabhaktike ||
mantraṃ na dūṣite dadyāt subījaṃ vipine tathā |
yatra yatra naraḥ pūjāṃ nirjane kurute ca yaḥ ||
tasyādatte svayaṃ devī patraṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ jalam |
śilā praśastā pūjāyāṃ sthaṇḍilaṃ nirjanaṃ tathā ||
dantarakte samutpanne smaraṇaṃ ca na vidyate ||
jānūrdhve kṣataje jāte nityaṃ karma na cācaret ||
naimittikaṃ ca tadadhaḥ sravadrakto na cācaret |
dravye bhukte tvajīrṇe ca na vai bhuktvā ca kiṃcana ||
karma kuryānnaro nityaṃ sūtake mṛtake tathā |
patraṃ puṣpaṃ ca tāmbūlaṃ bheṣajatvena kalpitam ||
kaṇādipippalyantaṃ ca phalaṃ bhuktvā na cācaret |
ārtvijyaṃ brahmayajñaṃ ca śrāddhaṃ devayajaṃ ca yat |
gurumākṣipya vipraṃ ca prahṛtyaiva ca pāṇinā ||
yācitaṃ parakīyaṃ ca tathā paryuṣitaṃ ca yat |
idaṃ śivāyāḥ paramaṃ manoharaṃ karoti yo.nena tadīyapūjanam |
sa vāñchitārthaṃ samavāpya caṇḍikāgṛhaṃ prayātā nacireṇa bhairava ||

column3: dvitīyasya tu varṇasya caṇḍikā yoginī matā |
kavacaṃ tu tataḥ paścāt ṣaḍvarṇaṃ kavacaṃ tathā ||
aḥ pātu pūrvakāṣṭhāyāmāgneyyāṃ pātu kaḥ sadā ||
pātu co yamakāṣṭhāyāṃ do nairṛtyāṃ ca sarvadā |
māṃ pātu to.sau pāścātye śaktir vāyavyadiggatā ||
mūrdhni rakṣatu māṃ so.sau bāhau māṃ dakṣiṇe tu kaḥ ||
māṃ vāmabāhau caḥ pātu hṛdi ṭo māṃ sadāvatu |
taḥ pātu kaṇṭhadeśe māṃ kaṭyoḥ śaktistathāvatu ||
yaḥ pātu dakṣiṇe pāde ṣo māṃ vāmapāde tathā |
nairṛtye tvatha kūṣmāṇḍī pātu māṃ jagatāṃ prasūḥ ||
skandamātā paścimāyāṃ māṃ rakṣatu sadaiva hi |
kātyāyanī māṃ vāyavye pātu lokeśvarī sadā ||
kālarātrī tu kauberyāṃ sadā rakṣatu māṃ svayam |
brahmā māṃ pātu vadane padmayonir ayonijaḥ ||
mahāmāyā svayaṃ nābhau māṃ pātu parameśvarī ||
rudrāṇī pātu māṃ yāmyāṃ nairṛtyāṃ caṇḍanāyikā ||
īśvarī ca tathaiśānyāṃ pātu nityaṃ sanātanī |
agrataḥ pātu māmugrā pṛṣṭhato vaiṣṇavī tathā |
brahmāṇī dakṣiṇe pārśve nityaṃ rakṣatu śobhanā ||
kaumārī parvate pātu vārāhī salile ca mām ||
nārasiṃhī daṃṣṭribhaye pātu māṃ vipineṣu ca |
aindrī māṃ pātu cākāśe tathā sarvajale sthale ||
setuḥ sarvāṅgulīḥ pātu devādiḥ pātu karṇayoḥ |
hā pātu māṃ tathaivorvormāyā rakṣatu jaṅghayoḥ |
tvaci māṃ vai sadā pātu māṃ śambhuḥ pātu sarvadā |
nakhadantakaroṣṭhapādau rāṃ māṃ pātu sadaiva hi ||
devādiḥ pātu māṃ vastau devāntaḥ stanakakṣayoḥ |
etadādau tu yaḥ seturbāhye māṃ pātu dehataḥ ||
vaiṣṇavī tantramantro māṃ nityaṃ rakṣaṃśca tiṣṭhatu |
śrotrayor hūṃ phaḍityevaṃ nityaṃ rakṣatu kālikā |
oṃ aiṃ hrīṃ hrauṃ nāsikāyāṃ rakṣantī cāstu caṇḍikā |
oṃ hrīṃ hūṃ māṃ sadā tārā jihvāmūle tu tiṣṭhatu ||
hṛdi tiṣṭhatu me seturjñānaṃ rakṣitum uttamam |
oṃ kṣauṃ phaṭ ca mahāmāyā pātu māṃ sarvataḥ sadā ||
oṃ yuṃ saḥ prāṇān kauśikī māṃ prāṇānrakṣatu rakṣikā |
hrīṃ hūṃ sauṃ bhargadayitā dehaśūnyeṣu pātu mām ||
oṃ namaḥ sadā śailaputrī sarvān rogān pramṛjyatām |
oṃ hrīṃ saḥ spheṃ kṣaḥ phaḍastrāya siṃhavyāghrabhayādraṇāt ||
śivadūtī pātu nityaṃ hrīṃ sarvāstreṣu tiṣṭhatu |
oṃ hāṃ hīṃ saścaṇḍaghaṇṭā karṇacchidreṣu pātu mām ||
oṃ krīṃ saḥ kāmeśvarī kāmānabhitiṣṭhatu rakṣatu |
oṃ āṃ hūṃ phaḍugracaṇḍā ripūn vighnān vimardatām ||
oṃ aṃ śūlātpātu nityaṃ vaiṣṇavī jagadīśvarī |
oṃ kaṃ brahmāṇī pātu cakrāt ca rudrāṇī tu śaktitaḥ ||
oṃ ṭaṃ kaumārī pātu vajrāttaṃ vārāhī tu kāṇḍataḥ |
oṃ paṃ pātu nārasiṃhī māṃ kravyādebhyastathāstrataḥ ||
caṇḍikā māṃ sadā pātu yaṃ saṃ devyai namo namaḥ |
oṃ namo mahāmāyāyai oṃ vaiṣṇavyai namo namaḥ |
ādhāre vāyumārge hṛdi kamaladale candravat smerasūrye vastau vahnau samiddhe viśatu varadayā mantramaṣṭākṣaraṃ tat |
yadbrahmā mūrdhni dhatte harir avati gale candracūḍo hṛdisthaṃ taṃ māṃ pātu pradhānaṃ nikhilamatiśayaṃ padmagarbhābhabījam
ādyāḥ śeṣāḥ svaraughair mamayavalavarair asvareṇāpi yuktaiḥ sānusvārāvisargair hariharaviditaṃ yatsahasraṃ ca sāṣṭam |
mantrāṇāṃ setubandhaṃ nivasati satataṃ vaiṣṇavītantramantre tanmāṃ pāyātpavitraṃ paramaparamajaṃ bhūtalavyomabhāge ||
aṅgānyaṣṭau tathāṣṭau vasava iha tathaivāṣṭamūrtir dalāni proktānyaṣṭau tathāṣṭau madhumatiracitāḥ siddhayo .ṣṭau tathaiva |
aṣṭāvaṣṭāṣṭasaṃkhyā jagati ratikalāḥ kṣiprakāṣṭhāṅgayogā mayyaṣṭāvakṣarāṇi kṣaratu na hi gaṇo yaddhṛdo yastvamūṣām ||

column3: sa sarvayajñasya phalaṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
dahettṛṇaṃ yathā vahnistathā śatruṃ dahet sadā ||
nāstrāṇi tasya śastrāṇi śarīre praviśanti vai |
na tasya jāyate vyādhirna ca duḥkhaṃ kadācana ||
yo nyaset kavacaṃ dehe tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu |
na śoṣayati taṃ vāyuḥ kravyāt taṃ na hinasti ca |
śastrāṇi nainaṃ chindanti na tāpayati bhāskaraḥ ||
na tasya jāyate vighno nāsti tasya ca saṃjvaraḥ |
nityaṃ paṭhati yo bhaktyā kavacaṃ haranirmitam ||
likhitaṃ yasya gehe tu kavacaṃ bhairavasthitam ||
na tasya durgatiḥ kvāpi jāyate tasya dūṣaṇam |
grahāśca sarve tuṣyanti vaśaṃ gacchanti bhūmipāḥ ||
etad dvayaṃ tu jihvāgre satataṃ yasya vartate |
tasya devī mahāmāyā kāye tiṣṭhati vai sadā ||
